title: ClipboardEnvelope
description: What the diagram editor puts on the system clipboard (text/plain JSON) when elements are copied: the copied nodes, the connections between them, sticky notes and shapes of one diagram level, plus what a paste into another model or project needs (library block sources, global parameters, docs images, CSV data files). A paste refuses an unknown format or version.

version.description: Envelope version. A reader refuses versions it does not know.

id.description: Random id of one copy; repeated pastes of the same copy cascade.

connections.description: Only connections whose two ends are copied nodes; a reader drops any other.

source.title: ClipboardSource
source.description: Where the copy was made. project and model are null when no saved model was open.

path.description: Subsystem node ids from the root to the copied diagram level (the editor's activePath).

dependencies.title: ClipboardDependencies
dependencies.description: What the copied elements use from their model and project, collected recursively through subsystems.

libraryBlocks.description: Project library blocks (project:<Name>) used by the copied nodes, and the project blocks their sources instantiate.

globals.description: Global parameters read by the copied params, starts and constants, with every global they depend on.

assets.description: Docs images (assets/<hash>.<ext> of the source model) that copied sticky notes show.

dataFiles.description: CSV files of the source project's data/ folder that copied CsvSource nodes read.

source.description: The block source; absent when the copying editor did not have it (the paste then reads it from the source project).

omitted.title: ClipboardOmitted
omitted.description: How many model-level items refer to the copied elements and are not carried along.
